tagline: A clear Saturday in Islamabad. High 32.

pending.title: Read the morning paper before the board

desk_column.headline: Finish the furniture, then stop
body: The board is short. The render lock is the only card that should move before lunch.
The paper card can wait until the PDF opens cleanly in Preview.

articles.headline: A zodiacal night over the dark sky
articles.dek: NASA's picture of the day is a band of dust light, not a headline reprint.
body: The night sky over a dry horizon showed the zodiacal light as a faint cone, the sort of thing a morning reader actually stops for.
NASA published the frame as the astronomy picture of the day. The glow is sunlight scattered by dust in the plane of the solar system, not a weather effect and not a city haze.
It is a Saturday picture: one photograph, a short caption, and a reason to look up after the desk is clear.

articles.headline: A short indigo class, if you have an afternoon
body: A weekend workshop in block print and dye is the sort of crafts brief this paper keeps: one thing to do, not a lecture, and not a repeat of last week's pot.

articles.headline: Aid trucks wait at the crossing again
body: Trucks carrying food and medicine remained stacked at the crossing overnight, a last-24-hours note without a death toll the desk cannot confirm.

articles.headline: Open weights are not open source
body: The Register's morning brief is a naming fight: labs keep calling dumped model files open source when the license is not.
